title: Liposuction
what: Through tiny openings, the surgeon inserts a thin tube and suctions fat from chosen areas. It reshapes the body. It is not a way to lose weight.
why: When fat stays in certain areas, such as the belly, thighs, or flanks, while your weight is normal.
duration: surgery usually takes 1 to 3 hours; you often go home the same day or the next
tell_doctor: All your medicines, especially blood thinners. Your doctor will say what to stop and when
Allergies to medicines, latex, or iodine
Heart or lung disease, or diabetes
Past blood clots in the veins

prepare.title: Tests
prepare.text: Blood tests, an ECG, and sometimes a GP checkup. The clinic will give you a list.

prepare.title: Anesthetist
prepare.text: Before surgery, an anesthetist will talk with you. Tell them about your health and medicines.

prepare.title: Food and water
prepare.text: Usually no food from the night before and no drinks for a few hours. The clinic will tell you the exact time.

prepare.title: Garment
prepare.text: A compression garment is usually needed. It is fitted in advance.

steps: The surgeon marks the areas with a pen while you stand
The anesthetist gives general anesthesia or other numbing
A special solution is injected through tiny openings
Fat is suctioned out with a thin tube
The openings are closed, and a compression garment is put on
feel: Pain like after a hard workout. You will get painkillers
Swelling and bruising for a few weeks
Pink fluid may leak from the openings for the first 1 to 2 days
after: The compression garment is usually worn for a few weeks
Walk from the first day. It protects against blood clots
Saunas, exercise, and sun when your doctor allows
The final result usually shows after a few months
If you gain weight, fat may build up in other places
red_flags: Sudden shortness of breath or chest pain: call emergency services
Pain and swelling in the calf
A fever over 38°C (100.4°F), or redness and pus at the openings

faq.q: Can I lose weight with liposuction?
faq.a: No. It changes the shape of certain areas, not your overall weight.
There will be less fat in the treated areas. But if you gain weight, it will build up elsewhere.

reminders.text: Liposuction tomorrow. Bring your compression garment and documents. Eat and drink only until the time the clinic gave you.
